skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Know-how agents load when a task needs it, versioned like instructions. Runs use a published version, never a draft.
skills.name: Name
skills.nameHint: Agents see the name and the description when they choose a skill.
skills.descriptionLabel: Description · what an agent reads to decide whether to load it
skills.descriptionHint: One or two sentences: when it applies and what it helps with.
skills.descriptionPlaceholder: When an agent should load this skill
skills.bodyPlaceholder: What an agent should know or do, in Markdown
skills.reloadQuestion: Replace local edits with the saved draft?
skills.reloadDetail: Local edits will be replaced only after the saved draft is read successfully.

version.stale: Draft of v{{basedOn}} · v{{version}} published since

skills.emptyDetail: A skill is know-how an agent loads when a task needs it: a name and a description it is chosen by, a Markdown body and reference files. Write one, or import what this repository already gives its agents.
skills.newNote: Starts an empty draft for the whole project. Nothing reaches an agent until you publish it.
skills.ownership: Skills belong to {{project}} and reach agents from Orchester. The repository’s own skills folders are read only while Project settings › Repository agent files is on.
skills.noRepository: Agents get skills only from Orchester. The repository has no AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md or skills folders to import.
skills.howScope: Project: every agent. Role: agents of that profile. Pipeline or step: only agents working there.
skills.howPublish: Publishing turns the draft into the next version. New runs load it; a draft never reaches an agent.
skills.howKeep: A run keeps the skill versions it started with, even after a newer one is published.
skills.publishEffect: Publishing applies to new runs. Active runs keep v{{version}}.
skills.publishFirst: Publishing makes v1, which new runs load.
skills.publishQuestion: Publish this skill for new runs?
skills.publishReason: New runs will receive this skill’s saved content and reference files in its chosen scope.
skills.filesDetail: Published with the skill. The agent opens them when the body points to them.
skills.originNote: Editing here never changes {{source}} in the repository, and later changes there do not reach this skill.
skills.repositoryExplain: Codex reads AGENTS.md and .agents/skills while this setting is on. Claude Code loads neither. Native agents load repository skills while it is on.
skills.filesQuestion: Allow agents to read repository agent files?
skills.filesReason: Agents will receive repository instructions and skills outside Orchester’s published versions.
skills.importDetail: Found in {{folder}}. Choose what becomes a draft in Orchester; open an item to see what it will contain.
skills.importInstructions: INSTRUCTIONS · EACH BECOMES A DRAFT PROJECT INSTRUCTION
skills.importSkills: SKILLS · EACH BECOMES A DRAFT SKILL
skills.importNotice: Creates drafts only: nothing is published and no repository file changes
skills.importNoticeDetail: You review and publish each draft yourself. Repository files keep their own content.
skills.onlyImports: Only points to {{targets}} · nothing to import
skills.notText: The file is not UTF-8 text.
skills.resultNote: Skill drafts start with the scope Project. Set each one’s scope in the editor before you publish it.
skills.publishWaiting: Publish waits until the draft is saved.
skills.leaveDetail: Saved drafts are kept. Changes that have not saved will be left behind.
skills.refreshFailed: The skills could not be refreshed. The last read stays visible.
skills.toolStep: Tool steps run a command, so no agent is there to load a skill.
skills.previewScope: Project · change it in the editor
skills.instructionEditorUnavailable: Instruction editor is not built yet.
